extraction_text: Employees displaced and terminated due to the closing of a plant or depot and the discontinuance of its operations, due to the introduction of labor-saving equipment, shall be entitled to severance pay subject to the following requirements and qualifications:

E. Notwithstanding the eligibility requirements set forth in Section A above, all regular employees covered by this Agreement shall be entitled to severance pay as provided above if such employee is laid off, after the exercise of his seniority rights, because his Employer had instituted hourly rated routes and reduced the number of commission routes.
